rows.commentary: 5.2: Axar Patel floats it up, and Finn Allen clears his front leg to launch a majestic six sailing clean over long-off.
5.3: Axar Patel slides one through, Allen backs away to carve it through extra cover, squeezing out a frantic triple.
5.4: Daryl Mitchell marches down the pitch immediately, dispatching Axar Patel's delivery over long-on for an audacious opening maximum.
5.5: Axar Patel serves up a fuller length, which Daryl Mitchell wrists neatly toward extra cover.
5.6: Axar Patel drifts onto the pads, allowing Daryl Mitchell to clip it away and seal a profitable sixteen-run powerplay surge.
6.1: Mayank Yadav tests the batter with a hard length, and Daryl Mitchell steps across to nudge it toward midwicket.
6.2: Finn Allen drills a booming drive straight back, only to watch in disbelief as it crashes into the non-striker's stumps.
6.3: Mayank Yadav digs this one way too short over the batsman, drawing a routine wide call from the umpire.
6.3: Mayank Yadav rolls out a slower delivery, which Finn Allen waits on before lifting it gracefully past the bowler for four.
6.4: Mayank Yadav targets a wide length, foiling Finn Allen's shuffle-and-scoop attempt entirely.
6.5: Mayank Yadav bangs it in short, forcing Ishan Kishan to give chase and recover from a slip to field the pull.
6.6: Mayank Yadav rattles through a sharp delivery outside off that Daryl Mitchell cuts directly to Axar at backward point.
7.1: Axar serves it full, and Allen clears his front leg to launch it with brutal force straight over the sightscreen for a maximum.
7.2: Axar drops it slightly short at ninety-four kilometers per hour, allowing Allen to create space and chip the ball toward long-off for a single.
7.3: Axar delivers a length ball on off stump, which Daryl Mitchell wrists neatly through the mid-on region to collect one run.
7.4: Axar strikes as Finn Allen skies a towering catch into the grateful hands of Tilak Varma, ending a forty-five-run knock.
15.2: Bhuvneshwar lands it full on off, drilling it straight back into a half-stop by the bowler before trickling toward mid-wicket for a single.
15.3: Bhuvneshwar goes wide and back of a length, allowing Jacobs to stand tall and flat-bat it high over long-off despite Tilak Varma's tumble.
15.4: Bhuvneshwar fires in a high bouncer, drawing a frustrated swat from Jacobs as the umpire signals the over's second short-ball infraction.
15.4: Bhuvneshwar serves a free-hit full at the stumps, where Jacobs lofts it straight to Nitish at long-on for a caught dismissal that instantly dissolves into confusion.
15.5: Bhuvneshwar offers a fuller length outside off, prompting Phillips to squeeze it in front of square and scamper back for a sharp second run.
15.6: Bhuvneshwar keeps it fuller and outside off, letting Phillips reach out and steer it square on the off-side for a routine single.
16.1: Mayank drops in a slower short ball, inviting Phillips to swivel across and pull it over wide mid-wicket to seal his milestone T20I fifty.
16.2: Mayank delivers on a hard length around off, where Phillips hops up and awkwardly tugs it through mid-wicket for a single.
16.3: Mayank digs it short outside off at pace, catching the toe-end of Jacobs' early pull as the ball bounces cleanly through to Sanju Samson.
16.4: Mayank tests the batter with another short delivery, but Jacobs is ready to swivel across and launch it majestically over deep backward square leg.
16.5: Mayank pitches it at a hard length on off, resulting in an inside-halved drive from Jacobs that trickles toward mid-on for a single.
16.6: Mayank pushes full into the stumps, and Phillips clears his front leg to dispatch it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
17.1: Arshdeep Singh drifts it wide and full, sliding past Bevon Jacobs who merely nudges it behind square on the off-side for a brisk single.
17.2: Arshdeep Singh drops it short and angled across, and Glenn Phillips leans across to carve it cleanly behind square for a boundary.
17.3: Arshdeep Singh fires in a yorker that jams into Phillips, then instinctively kicks the ball onto the stumps to catch Bevon Jacobs short despite his desperate dive.
17.4: Arshdeep Singh delivers to Michael Bracewell, who turns it away towards deep square leg to collect a single.
1.6: Adam Milne probes just outside off with a tight delivery that Sanju Samson awkwardly under-edges onto his pad.
2.1: Lockie Ferguson sprays wildly down leg, forcing Tim Seifert into a desperate dive before extra runs are scrambled.
2.1: Lockie Ferguson angles a sharp delivery past Abhishek Sharma, who watches it pass without offering a shot.
2.2: Lockie Ferguson slides one across the left-hander, allowing Abhishek Sharma to steer it down to third man.
2.3: Lockie Ferguson watches in disbelief as Sanju Samson's lofted drive over cover ends up in a comical collision and boundary off Santner and GP.
2.4: Lockie Ferguson pitches into the right-hander, and Sanju Samson brutally launches it over long-on for a maximum.
2.5: Lockie Ferguson offers width on a length, and Sanju Samson elegantly lofts it over mid-off for four.
2.6: Lockie Ferguson loses his radar entirely, launching a wild delivery short and down leg that sails past a desperately diving Tim Seifert and races away for five wides.
2.6: Lockie Ferguson slips in a slower delivery angling into Sanju Samson, who misses his flick as the ball drops off his body to the turf, wrapping up a bruising twenty-two run over.
3.1: Adam Milne angles a length ball across Abhishek Sharma, who throws everything into the drive and slices a thick outside edge past the diving keeper's left hand for four.
3.2: Adam Milne sprays another five wides, pitching full and down the leg side past Abhishek Sharma's attempted flick to leave Tim Seifert completely stranded.
3.2: Adam Milne angles a delivery short of a good length across the left-hander, inducing Abhishek Sharma to flash hard away from his body and miss entirely.
3.3: Adam Milne attacks the channel on a fuller length as the ball nips away with the angle, prompting Abhishek Sharma to waft and get comprehensively beaten.

3.4: Adam Milne drops it fuller and wide of off stump, where Abhishek Sharma charges down the track and throws his bat at a drive that catches a thick edge, flying high to Tim Seifert's left and bounding over the ropes.
3.5: Adam Milne bangs the ball in short and angles it across Abhishek Sharma, but the delivery clears the batsman's head comfortably to signal a wide.
3.5: Adam Milne drops it back of a length across the left-hander, and Abhishek Sharma swivels instantly to hook it towering over deep backward square leg for a maximum.

3.6: Adam Milne slams another short delivery just outside off, and Abhishek Sharma swivels onto the front foot with supreme confidence to launch it high over mid-wicket for six, capping off a twenty-six run over.
13.2: Matt Henry delivers back of a length, and Shreyas Iyer instantly exploits the vacant mid-wicket pocket to scamper back for an energetic second run.
13.3: Matt Henry targets the summit of off stump, inducing Iyer to knock the ball toward long-on before Santner swoops in to aggressively restrict them to a single.
13.4: Matt Henry hits a hard length, but Axar Patel reads the angle, shuffles across with brilliant intent, and laps it wide of short fine to keep India's runs flowing.

13.5: Matt Henry fires a fullish delivery near off that Axar drives fiercely back, ricocheting off Henry's outstretched right hand perilously close to the stumps as Iyer watches from the non-striker's end.
13.6: Matt Henry absorbs twenty runs from the over as Shreyas Iyer premeditates the length brilliantly, hopping on one leg to launch a majestic pick-up shot sailing over deep backward square.
14.1: Lockie Ferguson angles a fuller delivery across the crease, and Axar Patel simply pushes it straight toward the cover fielder.
14.2: Lockie Ferguson errs down the leg side, leaving Axar Patel to safely inside the line while the umpire signals a wide.
14.2: Lockie Ferguson probes away on a back of a length, beating Axar Patel's attempted steer past the outside edge while stand-in skipper Mitchell wisely declines a review.
14.3: Lockie Ferguson strikes with a cramped delivery that catches Axar Patel's bat sticker and lobs gently to substitute Devon Conway at short mid-wicket for a crucial breakthrough.
14.4: Lockie Ferguson pitches back of a length around off, allowing Naman Dhir to stand tall and punch the ball cleanly to sweeper cover.
14.5: Lockie Ferguson digs it in close to off, where Iyer under-edges a dab down to third man and comfortably completes a hustled second run.

14.6: Ferguson digs it in short to Iyer, who hops and mistimes the pull straight toward Allen, only for the fielder to charge, slide, and put down a crucial chance with both hands as a stunned bowler drops to his haunches in disbelief.
15.1: Nathan Smith serves up a full delivery angling in, allowing Shreyas Iyer to whip it in front of square as Dhir rushes them back for an effortless second run.
15.2: Nathan Smith attacks around off with a fullish length, drawing a firm drive from Shreyas Iyer that squirts away backward of square off the inside edge.
15.3: Nathan Smith unleashes a 136kph fuller ball outside off, prompting Naman Dhir to flash hard and slice an outside edge down to third man.
15.4: Nathan Smith rolls out an 118kph off-pace bumper into the surface, which Shreyas Iyer expertly controls with a pulled shot in front of square for a comfortable brace.
18.1: Adam Milne delivers a good length outside off that slips past Shreyas Iyer’s slap, and Mitchell Santner snatches the low‑ground catch at extra cover, dismissing the skipper.
18.2: Adam Milne nails a lethal yorker targeting the base of the stumps, leaving Nitish Reddy scrambling just in time to jam his bat down and keep it out.
18.3: Adam Milne fires in a full toss at the stumps, which Nitish Reddy awkwardly swings away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
18.4: Adam Milne drops a full toss that Naman Dhir calmly waits for and punches cleanly between extra cover and mid-off for a boundary.
18.5: Adam Milne hurls a wide yorker that Naman Dhir cleverly steers behind square, picking up two runs with the aid of some tidy fielding in the deep.
18.6: Adam Milne digs out a 135kph delivery near yorker length, and Naman Dhir drills it down to long-off for a single to retain the strike.
19.1: Matt Henry bowls a wet‑ball full toss around off, but Naman Dhir misses the loft, yet his bottom hand drives it cleanly through mid‑off for a four.
19.2: Matt Henry serves a back of a length ball that Naman Dhir jabs into the leg side, wisely aborting a risky second run.
19.3: Matt Henry delivers a low full toss that Nitish Reddy bunts towards mid-off before surviving a frantic dash with a desperate full-length dive.
19.4: Matt Henry sends a short delivery to Naman Dhir, who plucks a top‑edge that sails over Seifert’s fine‑leg fence, sealing India’s victory with a six.
